faces.name: New Perspectives
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, draw three cards.
As long as you have seven or more cards in hand, you may pay {0} rather than pay cycling costs.

faces.name: New Player's Journey
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here, each player may search their library for a basic land card, put it into their hand, then shuffle.
Whenever you play a card from Foundations or a core set (including Alpha!), draw a card.
Whenever chaos ensues, you gain life equal to the number of years you've played Magic, rounded up. Then planeswalk.

faces.name: New Prahv Guildmage
faces.oracleText:
{W}{U}: Target creature gains flying until end of turn.
{3}{W}{U}: Detain target nonland permanent an opponent controls. (Until your next turn, that permanent can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated.)
